senses.gloss: वि॑—ष्कन्ध (वि॑-), n. (fr. वि + स्कन्ध) a partic. disease, AV.; TS. (cf. सं॑-स्कन्ध)
वि-ष्कन्ध See p. 953, col. 1.
वि—ष्कन्ध—दू॑षण mfn. destroying it, AV.
विष्क् cl. 10. P. विष्कयति to see, perceive, Dhātup. xxxv, 84, v.l.
विष्क m. (cf. विक्क) an elephant twenty years old, Śiś. xviii, 27 (Sch.)
वि-ष्कन्त्तृ or वि-स्कन्त्तृ mfn. (वि + √ स्कन्द्; cf. Pāṇ. viii, 3, 73) moving hither and thither, restless, Bhaṭṭ.
वि-ष्कन्त्तृ or वि-स्कन्त्तृ mfn. (वि + √ स्कन्द्; cf. Pāṇ. viii, 3, 73) moving hither and thither, restless, Bhaṭṭ.
वि-स्कन्त्तृ , वि-स्कन्न. See p. 998, col. 2.
वि-˚ष्कन्द m. dispersing, going away, W.
वि-स्कन्न (not विष्कण्ण, cf. Pāṇ. viii, 3, 73) mfn. gone in different directions, dispersed, gone away, ib.
वि-√ स्कम्भ् See वि-ष्कम्भ्.
वि-ष्कब्ध mfn. fixed, supported &c., Pāṇ. vii, 2, 34, Sch.
वि॑-˚ष्कभित (वि॑-), mfn. fixed or held asunder (heaven and earth), RV.
वि-ष्कम्भ m. a prop, support, Lāṭy.; Suśr.
the bolt or bar of a door, Ragh., Sch.
the supporting beam or pillar of a house, W.
a post (round which the string of a churning-stick is wound), L.
width, extension, MBh.; VarBṛS.; MārkP.
the diameter of a circle, Āryabh.
a mountain-range (= -पर्वत), MārkP.
an obstacle, impediment, L.
the first of the twenty-seven astronomical periods called Yogas or the leading star of the first lunar mansion, Col.

(in dram.) an interlude or introductory scene (coming between the acts [अङ्कयोर् मध्य-वर्ती] and performed by an inferior actor or actors [नीच-पात्र-प्रयोजितः], who explains to the audience the progress of the plot, and inform them of what is supposed to have happened in the intervals of the acts, cf. प्रवेशक), Bhar.; Daśar. &c.
a partic. Yoga-posture, L.
a tree, L.
action, doing anything, W.
= प्रतिबिम्ब, L.
N. of a divine being reckoned among the Viśve Devāḥ, Hariv. (v.l. विस्कुम्भु, निकुम्ब, and विष्टर)
वि-ष्कम्भ—पर्वत m. a mountain-range, MārkP.
वि-ष्कम्भ—वत् mfn. (prob.) wealthy, opulent, Hcat.
वि-ष्कम्˚भार्ध m. or n. the radius of a circle, Āryav.
वि-˚ष्कम्भक mfn. propping, supporting, KātyŚr., Sch.
वि-˚ष्कम्भक m. (in dram.) an interlude (= विष्कम्भ), Ratnāv.; Bhar. &c.
a partic. astron. Yoga (= id.), W.
वि-˚ष्कम्भिका f. a piece of wood for supporting the pole of a carriage, KātyŚr., Sch.
वि-˚ष्कम्˚भक-काष्ठ n. = id., ib.
वि-˚ष्कम्भण n. the act of obstructing or impeding &c., L.
a means of tearing open, Divyāv.
वि-˚ष्कम्भित mfn. richly furnished with (comp.), Lalit.
driven away, rejected, Pañcat.
वि-˚ष्कम्भिन् mfn. obstructing, impeding, W.
वि-˚ष्कम्भिन् m. the bolt or bar of a door, ib.
N. of Śiva, MBh.
of a Bodhisattva, Buddh.
of a Tāntric deity, Kālac.
वि-ष्-कर m. (√ कृ, or कॄ?) the bolt of a door, L.
N. of a Dānava, MBh.
वि-ष्-कर n. a partic. manner of fighting, Hariv.
वि-ष्-किर m. (√ कॄ) ‘scatterer’, a gallinaceous bird (such as a domestic fowl, partridge, quail &c.), Gaut.; Yājñ. &c.
a partic. Agni, ĀpŚr.
any bird, W.
pulling or tearing to pieces, ib.
वि-ष्-किर—रस m. chicken-broth, Suśr.
वि-ष्कुम्भ् (√ स्कुम्भ्) P. -ष्कुभ्नाति, or -ष्कुभ्नोति, Vop.
विस्कुम्भु See वि-ष्कम्भ.
